title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #14

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In Sasankasana, where do your arms go at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Stretched forward on the floor
   B. On your head
   C. In the air
   D. Behind your back

2. What should you do if you break something at school? (1 mark)
   A. Run away
   B. Give it away
   C. Own up
   D. Blame another child

3. Which is safe behaviour in a matatu? (1 mark)
   A. Putting the head out of the window
   B. Standing in the aisle
   C. Wearing the seat belt
   D. Distracting the driver

4. What does Kapaal Bhaati mean? (1 mark)
   A. Diamond pose
   B. Moon pose
   C. Shining forehead
   D. Sitting pose

5. Which pose is called the hare or moon pose? (1 mark)
   A. Sasankasana
   B. Vajra Asana
   C. Kapaal Bhaati
   D. Bhastrika

6. To what does the Bhagavad Gita compare the soul in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A person who changes old clothes for new
   B. A river
   C. A tree
   D. A stone

7. What is a Tirthankar in Jainism? (1 mark)
   A. A temple
   B. A festival
   C. A king
   D. A teacher who shows the path across the river of life

8. Which three things does yoga join? (1 mark)
   A. Body, breath and mind
   B. Water, soil and air
   C. Books, pens and paper
   D. Rivers, trees and fire

9. What is patriotism? (1 mark)
   A. Fear of others
   B. Love for sweets
   C. Love for one's country
   D. Dislike of others

10. When is the Gayatri Mantra a good prayer to say? (1 mark)
   A. Before studying
   B. Only in the night
   C. Only at the market
   D. Never

11. Which principle is being followed by greeting parents with Namaste and saying a morning prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Punarjanam only
   B. Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   C. Artha only
   D. Kama only

12. Which Enlightened Being is Jain? (1 mark)
   A. Parshvanath
   B. Prahlad
   C. Narsimha
   D. Guru Ram Das

13. How does Namaste show the idea of Paramatma? (1 mark)
   A. It shows respect for the divine in everyone
   B. It means goodbye only
   C. It is a race
   D. It is a food

14. Which is honest behaviour with technology? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing your personal details with strangers
   B. Sending unkind messages
   C. Asking permission before using a device
   D. Copying someone's work

15. Which is a reason for celebrating festivals? (1 mark)
   A. To waste time
   B. To remember important events and teachings
   C. To stop learning
   D. To avoid friends

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe three rites and rituals in a Mandir. (3 marks)

17. Give four roles of sacred plants. (4 marks)

18. Describe how to make a decorated calendar. (4 marks)

19. List four facts about the planets linked with the days. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Stretched forward on the floor
   Arms are stretched forward.

2. C — Own up
   Owning up shows integrity.

3. C — Wearing the seat belt
   A seat belt protects you.

4. C — Shining forehead
   Kapaal is forehead and bhaati is shining.

5. A — Sasankasana
   Sasankasana.

6. A — A person who changes old clothes for new
   The body is like worn clothes.

7. D — A teacher who shows the path across the river of life
   Tirthankars guide people to freedom.

8. A — Body, breath and mind
   Yoga joins these three.

9. C — Love for one's country
   Patriotism is love for our country.

10. A — Before studying
   It is a prayer for wisdom.

11. B — Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   Prayer and respect for God.

12. A — Parshvanath
   Parshvanath is a Tirthankar of Jainism.

13. A — It shows respect for the divine in everyone
   Namaste honours the divine in others.

14. C — Asking permission before using a device
   Permission is part of responsible use.

15. B — To remember important events and teachings
   Festivals help us remember.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Darshan, aarti, prasad, bhajans, ringing the bell (any three, with a short description).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: They give oxygen and clean the air; they give shade for rest and prayer; their leaves, fruits and bark are used for food and medicine; their leaves and flowers are used in worship; they remind us to care for life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct role.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw a table with seven columns, write English and Indian names, draw the Sun, Moon and planets above their days, and decorate it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mercury is closest to the Sun; Mars is the red planet; Jupiter is the largest; Saturn has rings (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
